title: Follow Charger entrance queue → tote drop-off → charge (no totes on AGV) → tote pickup → exit queue
summary: Verify the charger-area flow described in the source: an AGV enters via the charger entrance queue, drops off its tote at the charger tote locations before charging (the AGV “doesn't like to charge with totes on it”), then after charging completes it picks up its tote in a shutdown state and proceeds to its exit queue. For AGVs without totes, confirm they skip the tote pickup/drop-off behavior.
when_to_use: Use when you need to confirm that AGVs are following the expected charger-area tote-handling and charging sequence (drop tote before charging; do not charge with tote on the AGV; pick up tote after charging; then go to exit queue).
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a recovery playbook for charger faults; the source provides no recovery steps if the behavior is incorrect.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Observe AGV behavior at the charger entrance queue, charger tote locations (drop-off), charging period (tote presence/absence), tote pickup after charging, and the exit queue; escalate if the AGV appears to charge with a tote still on it.
access_or_tools_needed: Live visibility of AGV behavior at the charger area (entrance queue, tote drop-off locations, charging, tote pickup, exit queue)
Source diagram/frame for charger module naming (charger, entrance queue, tote locations, exit queue)

system_preconditions: AGV is operating in/near the charger area such that you can observe entrance queue entry, tote drop-off, charging, tote pickup, and exit queue movement.

visual_references.description: Charger-area diagram/frame showing entrance queue, tote drop-off, pickup, and exit queue labels used to map the expected AGV flow.

steps.title: Identify the AGV’s charger entrance queue entry
steps.purpose: Establish the start of the expected charger flow so you can verify subsequent tote handling and charging behavior.
steps.instruction: At the charger area, locate the AGV as it enters the charger entrance queue and confirm it is moving into the charger area as described in the source.
steps.expected_result: The AGV is observed entering the charger area via the charger entrance queue.
steps.healthy_condition: You can visually track the same AGV from the charger entrance queue into the charger tote-handling portion of the flow.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot identify the AGV’s entrance queue entry, or the AGV appears to bypass the entrance queue.

actions.label: Track AGV into charger entrance queue
actions.exact_action: Visually identify the AGV at the charger entrance queue as it feeds into the charger area.

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: Transcript: “It has an entrance queue… it’s got tote locations, that’s where it drops off its tote while it goes charge.”

steps.title: Observe tote drop-off at charger tote locations before charging
steps.purpose: Confirm the tote is dropped off at the charger tote locations prior to charging.
steps.instruction: Watch the AGV at the charger tote locations and confirm it drops off its tote there before the charging period begins.
steps.expected_result: The AGV drops off its tote at the charger tote locations before charging.
steps.healthy_condition: During the transition into charging, the tote is no longer on the AGV and is instead left at the charger tote locations.
steps.failure_condition: The tote remains on the AGV when the AGV begins charging.

actions.label: Verify tote drop-off before charging
actions.exact_action: Visually confirm the tote is dropped at the charger tote locations before the AGV starts charging.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the AGV appears to begin charging while a tote is still on it, stop and escalate (the source states the AGV “doesn't like to charge with totes on it” and provides no recovery steps).

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: Transcript: “...that’s where it drops off its tote while it goes charge.”
Transcript: “It doesn't like to charge with totes on it.”

steps.title: Confirm charging occurs with no tote on the AGV
steps.purpose: Validate the explicit charging constraint stated by the source.
steps.instruction: During the charging period, confirm the tote is not on the AGV (the source states the AGV does not like to charge with totes on it).
steps.expected_result: The AGV charges while no tote is on the AGV.
steps.healthy_condition: You observe charging while the tote is absent from the AGV (tote is left at the charger tote locations).
steps.failure_condition: You observe charging while a tote is still on the AGV.

actions.label: Check tote presence during charging
actions.exact_action: Visually verify that the AGV has no tote on it during the charging interval.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the AGV appears to charge with a tote still on it, stop and escalate; the source does not provide recovery steps.

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: Transcript: “It doesn't like to charge with totes on it.”

steps.title: After charging completes, observe tote pickup in shutdown state
steps.purpose: Confirm the post-charging tote pickup behavior described by the source.
steps.instruction: After charging completes, observe the AGV as it goes to pick up its tote, noting that the source describes this as occurring in a shutdown state.
steps.expected_result: Once charging is done, the AGV goes to pick up its tote in a shutdown state.
steps.healthy_condition: You observe the AGV transitioning from charging to tote pickup and then taking the tote.
steps.failure_condition: The AGV completes charging but does not pick up a tote when one is expected to be available for pickup.

actions.label: Verify tote pickup after charging
actions.exact_action: Visually confirm the AGV picks up its tote after charging completes.

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: Transcript: “And then once it's done charging, it goes to pick up its tote…”

steps.title: Observe AGV proceeds to its exit queue after picking up the tote
steps.purpose: Confirm the end of the expected charger flow.
steps.instruction: After the AGV picks up its tote, observe it moving to the exit queue as described in the source.
steps.expected_result: The AGV goes to its exit queue after picking up the tote.
steps.healthy_condition: You can visually track the AGV from tote pickup to the exit queue.
steps.failure_condition: After tote pickup, the AGV does not proceed to the exit queue (or appears to remain in the charger area).

actions.label: Track AGV to exit queue
actions.exact_action: Visually confirm the AGV moves to the exit queue after tote pickup.

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: Transcript: “…And then it goes to its exit queue.”

steps.title: For AGVs without totes, confirm they skip tote pickup/drop-off behavior
steps.purpose: Validate the source-described exception for tote-less AGVs.
steps.instruction: Identify AGVs without totes and confirm they do not need to perform the tote pickup/drop-off behavior described for charging.
steps.expected_result: AGVs without totes skip the tote pickup/drop-off portion of the charger flow.
steps.healthy_condition: You observe tote-less AGVs charging without performing tote drop-off/pickup steps.
steps.failure_condition: A tote-less AGV attempts tote pickup/drop-off behavior that is not expected by the source.

actions.label: Check tote-less AGV behavior
actions.exact_action: Visually confirm an AGV without a tote does not perform the tote pickup/drop-off behavior described for charging.

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: Transcript: “There's some Agvs without tents, so it doesn't need to do that.”

success_criteria: An AGV follows the charger flow: entrance queue → tote drop-off at charger tote locations → charging with no tote on the AGV → tote pickup → exit queue.
For AGVs without totes, the tote pickup/drop-off portion is skipped.
healthy_conditions: During charging, the AGV has no tote on it (consistent with “doesn't like to charge with totes on it”).
After charging, the AGV picks up its tote and then proceeds to the exit queue.
Tote-less AGVs do not perform the tote pickup/drop-off behavior.
failure_conditions: AGV appears to charge with a tote still on it.
AGV does not drop off its tote at charger tote locations before charging (when it has a tote).
AGV does not pick up its tote after charging completes (when a tote is expected).
AGV does not proceed to the exit queue after tote pickup.
escalation_guidance: If an AGV appears to charge with a tote still on it (contrary to the source statement), stop and escalate. The source provides no recovery steps.

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: Charger-area labels/diagram elements for: entrance queue, tote/drop-off, pickup, and exit queue (used to map the expected physical flow).

source_refs.quote_or_evidence: Transcript: “It has an entrance queue… it’s got tote locations, that’s where it drops off its tote while it goes charge. It doesn't like to charge with totes on it. And then once it's done charging, it goes to pick up its tote… And then it goes to its exit queue.”
Transcript: “There's some Agvs without tents, so it doesn't need to do that.”

image_refs.what_to_look_at: Charger-area labels/diagram elements for: entrance queue, tote/drop-off, pickup, and exit queue (used to map the expected physical flow).

missing_details: The source does not provide explicit live UI indicators or specific observable status fields for “charging” vs “shutdown state”; this runbook relies on physical/visual observation only.
The source provides no recovery steps if the AGV charges with a tote on it or if the flow deviates.
